n-k-k6-02.title: Kooxaha kee ayaa gali kara?
n-k-k6-02.topic: Akhrinta qaanuunnada leh xadad: kooxo, nisbooyin iyo miisaaniyad
n-k-k6-02.goal: Akhri ogeysiis soo gelitaan oo qaanuunnadiisu is xadidaan, dhis dhawr koox oo buuxiya dhammaan qaanuunnada hal mar, oo sharax sababta hal nooc oo koox aysan waligeed shaqayn karin.
n-k-k6-02.material:
Kooxdaada xaruunta ayaa rabta inay booqato matxafka cilmiga carruurta. Waxaad akhrisay ogeysiiska oo go'aamisay miisaaniyad.

[어린이 과학관 단체 입장 안내]
- 요금: 어른 한 명 5,000원, 어린이 한 명 3,000원
- 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다. 어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지 들어갈 수 있습니다.
- 단체 입장은 모두 5명 이상일 때만 가능합니다.
- 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다.

Miisaaniyadda kooxdaada: 총 요금 25,000원 이하.
n-k-k6-02.thinking.0: U beddelidda erayada tirada Kuuriyaanka shuruudo
n-k-k6-02.thinking.2: Aragtida sida hal qaanuun u xadido mid kale
n-k-k6-02.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan 이상 / 이하 iyo 최대
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.prompt: Eeg qaanuunka ku saabsan dadka waaweyn iyo carruurta oo keliya (iska indho tir qiimaha iyo qaanuunnada cabbirka kooxda). Booqashadee ayaan la oggolayn?
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Akhri '어른 한 명당 어린이 세 명까지' sida qaanuun lagu dabaqo qof weyn kasta gooni ah.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Doorasho kasta, ku dhufo tirada dadka waaweyn tirada carruurta la oggol yahay oo is barbar dhig.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.b: La oggol yahay: hal qof weyn wuxuu keeni karaa ilaa saddex carruur ah, saddexna waa xadka laftiisa.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.c: La oggol yahay: laba qof oo waaweyn waxay keeni karaan ilaa lix carruur ah.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.r.d: La oggol yahay: afar qof oo waaweyn waxay keeni karaan ilaa laba iyo toban carruur ah.
n-k-k6-02.s.s1.explain: Xadku waa saddex carruur QOF WEYN KASTA. Laba qof oo waaweyn waxay keeni karaan ugu badnaan 2 x 3 = 6 carruur, sidaas darteed todoba aad bay u badan tahay.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.prompt: Dhis 3 koox oo kala duwan oo buuxiya qaanuun KASTA iyo miisaaniyadda. a = tirada dadka waaweyn, c = tirada carruurta.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Marka hore qor afarta shuruudood erayadaada (dad waaweyn, carruur qof weyn kasta, wadarta dadka, lacag).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Marka hore dooro tirada dadka waaweyn, kadibna hel tirooyinka carruurta ee ay oggolyihiin qaanuunka nisbada iyo qaanuunka 5-ka qof.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.hint.2: Lacagta ugu dambeyn hubi: 5,000 x dad waaweyn + 3,000 x carruur.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Isticmaal tirooyin dhan oo dad ah (0 ama ka badan carruur).
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 어른과 함께 와야 합니다: ugu yaraan hal qof weyn.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.ok.c2: Aan ka badnayn saddex carruur qof weyn kasta.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c2: Carruur aad u badan: ugu badnaan saddex qof weyn kasta.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c3: 단체 입장은 5명 이상: ugu yaraan 5 qof guud ahaan.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Wadarta khidmadda waa ka badan 25,000 won.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.fail.c5: 어린이가 1명 이상 있는 단체만 신청할 수 있습니다: ugu yaraan hal ilmo.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.explain: Tusaale 2 qof weyn + 3 carruur = 19,000 won; 3 + 2 = 21,000 won; 4 + 1 = 23,000 won. Lix koox oo dhan ayaa ku habboon: (2,3), (2,4), (2,5), (3,2), (3,3), (4,1). Ogeysiisku wuxuu bixiyaa xadado, ma aha hal koox oo sax ah.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Isku day koox leh sax HAL qof weyn. Hal ama laba weedhood (Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan), sharax sababta koox caynkaas ahi u buuxin karin qaanuunnada. Isticmaal tirooyin.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Tiri dadka ugu badan ee koox leh hal qof weyn yeelan karto.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Is barbar dhig tirooyinkaas iyo qaanuunka cabbirka kooxda.
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Ma isticmaalay xadka 3-ka carruur iyo ugu yaraan 5-ka qof isku mar?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Ma tirooyinkaygu sidoo kale waxay shaqayn lahaayeen 2 qof oo waaweyn?
n-k-k6-02.s.s2.because.model.1: Marka ay jirto 1 qof weyn, ugu badnaan 3 carruur ayaa imaan kara, sidaas darteed kooxdu waa 4 qof oo keliya, laakiin ugu yaraanku waa 5.

n-k-k6-05.s.s1.prompt: Akhri qayb kasta, dooro akhrinta u muuqata inay ugu macquulsan tahay, kadibna sii wad.
n-k-k6-05.title: Ma samaystay shaqada guriga?
n-k-k6-05.topic: Aan-caddaanta fariin: 다 + 안 waxay macnaheedu noqon karaa 'midna' ama 'dhammaan maaha'
n-k-k6-05.goal: Akhri wada hadal gaaban marxalado, arag in 'ㅡ 다 안 했어요' ay laba macne yeelan karto, dib u eeg akhrinta marka faahfaahin timaado, oo qor weedho aan lahayn aan-caddaan.
n-k-k6-05.material: Macallin ayaa ka weydiiyay shaqada guriga. Shaqada guriga waxay lahayd 10 dhibaato.
n-k-k6-05.thinking.1: Dib u eegidda akhris marka faahfaahin cusub timaado
n-k-k6-05.thinking.2: Dib u qorista fariin si aan loo khaldin
n-k-k6-05.prereq.0: Wuu yaqaan 안 + fal iyo 못 + fal
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Go'aami adigoo isticmaalaya waxa aad akhrisay ilaa hadda oo keliya, oo cod dheer u sheeg macne kasta oo weedhdu yeelan karto.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Weydii macnayaasha weli ku habboon marka khaduyada cusub la daro.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Labada akhris labaduba waa suurtagal: '다 안 했어요' waxay macnaheedu noqon kartaa 'midna ma samayn' ama 'dhammaan ma samayn'. '죄송해요' wuxuu muujinayaa inay wax maqan yihiin, laakiin ma muujiyo intee.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Wuxuu samayn waayay shaqada guriga midna.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Wuxuu qayb ka sameeyay laakiin ma dhammaystirin.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wuu ka raalli galay ('죄송해요'), taas oo aan ku habboonayn dhammaystirka dhammaan.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Wuxuu shaqada guriga u sameeyay fasal kale.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Khaduyada midna ma sheegto fasal kale.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Hadda maxay ahayd macnaha '숙제를 다 안 했어요'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Faahfaahintu way go'aamisaa: 8 ka mid ah 10 dhibaato ayaa la sameeyay, sidaa darteed weedhdu waxay ula jeeday 'dhammaan maaha'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wuxuu leeyahay wuxuu sameeyay dhibaatooyinka 1 ilaa 8.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Inta badan wuu sameeyay oo wuxuu seegay labada dhibaato ee ugu dambeeya.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Wuxuu sameeyay qiyaastii kala bar oo keliya.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Siddeed ka mid ah toban waa ka badan kala bar.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Jawaabtiisa labaad waxay sheegaysaa dhibaatooyinka uu sameeyay si sax ah.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Weedheed 유나 qori lahayd si macallinku u khaldami waayo 'inta badan sameeyay'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '하나도 안 했어요' ma ka tago meel 'qayb'. '다는 못 했어요' waa hab cad oo loogu yiraahdo 'dhammaan maaha'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Tani waa isla weedhii labada dhinac ee hore; ma meesha ka saarto 'qayb ayaa la sameeyay'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Tani waxay u dhawaaqaysaa 'qayb ayaa la sameeyay laakiin dhammaan maaha', ka soo horjeedka waxa 유나 rabto inay tiraahdo.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Tani waxay tidhaahdaa waxay samaysay ku dhawaad dhammaan.
n-k-k6-05.s.s1.reflect: Ogow in isla erayadu isku mid ahaadeen oo faahfaahinta oo keliya ayaa beddeshay akhrintaada. Hadlaha doonaya inuu hubo in la fahmo waa inuu doorto erayo oggolaada hal macne oo keliya.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.prompt: Weedhahaas kuwee ayaa la khaldi karaa sida '숙제를 다 안 했어요'?
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka hel weedhda eray macnaheedu 'dhammaan' uu kula kulmo eray taban.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Isku day inaad weedh kasta ku sheegto adigoo maanka ku haynaya laba xaaladood oo kala duwan oo arag kuwee labadaba ku habboon yihiin.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.b: Tani waxay tidhaahdaa martida weli ma imaan; ma laha kala qaybin 'dhammaan ama midna'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.c: Tani si cad ayay tidhaahdaa midna ma yimid.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.r.d: Tani waxay tidhaahdaa dad yar ayaa yimid; ma ka tagto 'midna ama dhammaan maaha'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s2.explain: '다' (dhammaan) oo ay raacdo taban waxaa loo akhrin karaa 'midna' ama 'dhammaan maaha', sidaa darteed '손님이 다 안 왔어요' waxay leedahay isla labada akhris.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.prompt: Qor laba weedh oo Kuuriyaan ah (hadal edeb leh), mid kasta oo ku saabsan hawl KALA DUWAN (tusaale ahaan shaqada guriga, nadiifinta ama buug). Weedhda 1: ma samayn midna hawsha koowaad. Weedhda 2: qayb keliya ayaad ka samaysay hawsha labaad. Ha isticmaalin '다 안' ama '다 못' weedh midna.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.hint.1: 'Qayb' sheeg intii aad samaysay (kala bar, wax yar, ilaa xad) ama isticmaal qaab macnaheedu yahay 'dhammaan maaha'.
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma weedh kasta oo ii gaar ahi waxaa lagu akhrin karaa hal hab oo keliya?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma labada weedhood runtii waxay qeexayaan xaddi kala duwan?
n-k-k6-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Mawduucyo kala duwan sidoo kale waa fiican yihiin.

n-k-k6-04.title: Ma soo koobiddu waxay la mid tahay warbixinta?
n-k-k6-04.topic: Si daacad ah u soo koobidda sahan: waxa warbixintu taageerto
n-k-k6-04.goal: Barbardhig soo koobid blog fasal-wadaag iyo warbixin wargeyska dugsiga, ka hel khaduyaasha warbixintu aanay taageerin, oo hagaaji mid ka mid ah.
n-k-k6-04.material:
Wargeyska dugsigu wuxuu daabacay warbixin gaaban. 하준 wuxuu ku soo koobay blog-ka fasalka saaxiib aan wargeyska akhrin karin.

[학교 신문: 급식 설문 결과]
- 조사 대상: 6학년 2반 학생 24명 (6학년은 모두 다섯 반입니다.)
- 18명은 "급식이 맛있다", 6명은 "보통이다"라고 답했습니다. "맛없다"고 답한 학생은 없었습니다.
- 급식을 남기지 않는 학생은 14명이었습니다.
n-k-k6-04.thinking.2: Dib u qorista khad si uu ula mid noqdo caddayntiisa
n-k-k6-04.prereq.0: Wuu yaqaan tirooyinka 명 iyo 반
n-k-k6-04.prereq.1: Wuu akhriyi karaa warbixin gaaban iyo hadal la gudbiyay (-대 / -래)
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.prompt: Barbardhig soo koobidda 하준 iyo warbixinta. Dooro hal khad oo soo koobid ah oo warbixintu AANAY taageerin. (In ka badan hal khad ayaa khaldan.)
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Qaado soo koobidda khad khad oo ka hel weedhda warbixinta ay ka timid.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Khad kasta, barbardhig ardayda tirooyinka warbixintu ku saabsan yihiin iyo ardayda khaddu ka hadlayo.
n-k-k6-04.s.s1.explain: Khaduyada 2, 4 iyo 6 waa khalad. Warbixintu waxay weydiisay kaliya 24 arday oo 6학년 2반, sidaa darteed waxba ma sheegto ardayda dhammaan fasalka lixaad, fasallada kale ama dugsiga oo dhan. Khaduyada 1, 3 iyo 5 waxay ku saabsan yihiin fasalkaas oo waxay la mid yihiin warbixinta.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.prompt: Khaduyada khaldan waxay wadaagaan hal shay. Noocee khalad ah?
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Khad kasta oo aad dooratay, sheeg ardayda warbixintu ku saabsan tahay iyo ardayda khaddu ku saabsan tahay.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Raadi waxa saddexda khad wadaagaan marka aad barbardhigto labadaas kooxood.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.a: Tirooyinka warbixinta si khaldan ayaa loo koobiyay.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.a: Tirooyinka 24 iyo 14 ee soo koobidda waxay la mid yihiin warbixinta.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.b: Wax laga ogyahay hal fasal ayaa loo sheegay koox ka weyn.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.c: Dhammaadyada edebta leh waxaa loo beddelay kuwo aan rasmi ahayn.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.c: Dhammaadyada aan rasmi ahayn waa caadi soo koobid saaxiib loo qoray mana aha khalad macne ah.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.o.d: Natiijooyin qaar ka mid ah sahanka waa laga reebay soo koobidda.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.r.d: Khaduyada khaldan waxay ku daraan sheegasho; ma tuuraan natiijooyin.
n-k-k6-04.s.s2.explain: Warbixintu waxay ku saabsan tahay 24 arday hal fasal ah. Khaduyada khaldan waxay natiijadaas u fidiyaan dhammaan fasalka lixaad, fasallada kale, ama dugsiga oo dhan, taas oo warbixintu weligeed aysan sheegin.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.prompt: Dib u qor khadka ugu dambeeya ee soo koobidda (oo ku saabsan cunto aan la reebin) si uu u sheego waxa warbixintu sheegto oo keliya (hadal aan rasmi ahayn saaxiibkaa waa fiican yahay).
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.0: Ka hel weedhda warbixinta ee khadkani ka yimid oo xus saxda yaa iyo intee la magacaabay.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.hint.1: Dib u qor khadka adigoo isticmaalaya kooxdaas iyo tiradaas oo keliya.
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma khadkaygu wuxuu magacaabayaa kooxda warbixintu weydiisay?
n-k-k6-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma ilaaliyay tirada sida warbixintu bixiso, iyadoo aan loo beddelin 'inta badan' ama 'dhammaan'?

n-k-k6-01.title: Akhrinta tirooyinka maktabadda
n-k-k6-01.topic: Qiimaynta sheegashooyinka iyo cadaynta: waxa shax tirooyin ahi muujin karto
n-k-k6-01.goal: Go'aami hadallada ay shaxda yar ee tirooyinka maktabadda runtii taageerto, hel farqiga u dhexeeya cinwaanka boosteerka iyo shaxda, oo sharax adigoo isticmaalaya tiro.
n-k-k6-01.material:
Maktabad xaafadeed ayaa dhigtay shax iyo boosteer.

[우리 동네 도서관 3월 이용 현황]
구분 | 작년 3월 | 올해 3월
이용자 수 | 2,400명 | 3,000명
빌려 간 책 | 5,200권 | 5,100권
(올해 3월부터 1층에 무료 공부방을 열었습니다.)

[포스터]
"도서관 덕분에 우리 동네 사람들이 책을 더 많이 읽게 되었습니다!"
n-k-k6-01.thinking.0: Kala saarista waxa shaxdu tirisay iyo waxa sheegashadu leedahay
n-k-k6-01.thinking.1: Kala saarista hadal la taageeray iyo mid rajo ah
n-k-k6-01.thinking.2: Isticmaalka tiro sida cadayn sharaxaad ku jirta
n-k-k6-01.prereq.0: Wuxuu akhrin karaa tirooyin leh 명 iyo 권
n-k-k6-01.prereq.1: Wuxuu yaqaan 늘다 / 줄다 iyo 작년 / 올해
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.prompt: Hadallee ayaa shaxdu laftigeedu taageertaa, qiyaas la'aan? Dooro dhammaan kuwa quseeya.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Calaamadee hadal kasta 'tiro aan tilmaami karo' ama 'wax ay tahay inaan qiyaaso'.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Hadallada ku saabsan tirooyinka, hel labada tiro oo is barbar dhig jihada saxda ah.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.a: Jeclaanshaha buugaagta waa dareen; shaxdu waxay tirisaa booqasho iyo buugaag la amaahday, ma aha dareenno.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.c: Mar kale is barbar dhig 5,200 iyo 5,100: tirada buugaagta la amaahday waxay u dhaqaaqday jihada kale.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.r.d: Shaxdu waxay liis garaysaa qolka waxbarashada sida qoraal dhinac ah oo keliya; ma muujiyo in qolku yahay sababta kororka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s1.explain: Shaxdu waxay muujisaa 2,400 ilaa 3,000 booqdayaal (ka badan) iyo 5,200 ilaa 5,100 buug la amaahday (wax yar ka yar). Dareenno iyo sababo shaxda kuma jiraan, 'buugaag badan' waa lidka waxa ay muujinayso.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.prompt: Waa maxay farqiga ugu weyn ee u dhexeeya cinwaanka boosteerka iyo shaxda?
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Hoos u xariiq falka cinwaanka boosteerka, kadibna hel saf shaxda ah oo cabbirta isla wax.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Is barbar dhig waxa saf kasta oo shaxda ah tirisay iyo waxa cinwaanku yidhi dadku sameeyeen.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.a: Boosteerku wuxuu ka hadlaa sannadkii hore, laakiin shaxdu waxay muujisaa sannadkan oo keliya.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.a: Shaxdu waxay leedahay tiir sannadkii hore iyo tiir sannadkan labadaba.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.b: Boosteerku wuxuu leeyahay dadku wax badan ayay akhriyaan, laakiin shaxdu waxay muujisaa booqdayaal ka yar.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.b: Shaxdu waxay muujisaa booqdayaal ka badan, ma aha kuwa ka yar.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.c: Boosteerku waa sax, sababtoo ah maktabad mashquul ah macnaheedu waa akhris badan.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.r.c: Booqdayaal badan isku mid ma aha akhris badan: dadku waxay u iman karaan sababo kale, tirada amaahdana ma kicin.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.o.d: Boosteerku wuxuu ka hadlaa akhris, laakiin shaxdu waxay tirisaa booqasho iyo amaah, amaahduna ma kicin.
n-k-k6-01.s.s2.explain: 'Akhrinta oo badan' ma aha wax shaxdu tirisay. Cabbirka ugu dhow waa buugaag la amaahday, wuuna kicin. Booqdayaal badan waxay noqon karaan natiijo qolka waxbarashada cusub, laakiin shaxdu ma sheegi karto.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.prompt: 1-2 weedhood (Ingiriis ama Kuuriyaan), dheh haddii shaxdu taageerto cinwaanka boosteerka iyo sababta. Isticmaal ugu yaraan hal tiro oo shaxda ka timid.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.0: Magacaaw safka shaxda ee ugu dhow 'akhris', oo sheeg labadiisa tiro.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kadibna dheh waxa safkaas AAN muujin ee ku saabsan cinwaanka boosteerka.
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegay waxa shaxdu cabbirto iyo waxa boosteerku sheegayo?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma tirodayda waxaan dhigay meel ay u shaqayso sida cadayn, ma aha inaan koobiyeeyo oo keliya?
n-k-k6-01.s.s3.model.0: Shaxdu waxay muujisaa booqdayaal ka badan (2,400 ilaa 3,000), laakiin buugaagta la amaahday waxay ka dhaceen 5,200 ilaa 5,100, sidaas darteed ma muujiso in dadku wax badan akhriyeen.

n-k-k6-03.title: Ma coupon-ku wuxuu ku filan yahay inuu go'aamiyo?
n-k-k6-03.topic: Ku filnaanshaha macluumaadka: waxa coupon-ku sheego iyo waxa uu furan ka tago
n-k-k6-03.goal: Kala saar waxa coupon-ku horey u jawaabay iyo waxa uu furan ka tago, kadibna ka jawaab saaxiib adigoo saxaya hal qodob oo weydiinaya kan furan.
n-k-k6-03.material:
Maanta waa Isniin, 4월 27일. Saaxiibkaa 민아 ayaa kuu soo diraysa fariin iyo coupon.

민아: 나 카페 쿠폰 받았어! 이번 주 목요일 수업 끝나고 세 시쯤 학교 앞 모아카페에 가자. 아메리카노 두 잔 시키면 쿠폰으로 4,000원 할인받을 수 있어!

[아메리카노 2,000원 할인 쿠폰]
- 유효 기간: 4월 30일까지
- 사용 매장: 모아카페 전 지점
- 1회 사용 (쿠폰 한 장당)
- 다른 할인과 중복 불가
- 그 밖의 조건은 앱에서 확인하세요.
n-k-k6-03.thinking.0: Hubinta sheegasho iyadoo la eegayo far yar
n-k-k6-03.thinking.1: Helitaanka xaqiiqada keliya ee weli maqan
n-k-k6-03.thinking.2: Weydiinta waxa loo baahan yahay oo keliya
n-k-k6-03.prereq.0: Wuxuu yaqaan taariikho iyo maalmaha usbuuca

n-k-k6-03.s.s1.prompt: Haddii aad raacdo qorshaha 민아 oo aad isticmaasho kuuboonkan hal mar laba Americano Khamiista, bayaanee run yahay?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Doorasho kasta ku tijaabi khaduyada kuuboonka ee la daabacay: kuwee ayaad xaqiijin kartaa iyo kuwee ayaad beeninkarto?
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Xisaabi waxa qorshuhu ku kici lahaa kuuboon iyo la'aan kuuboon, adigoo isticmaalaya waxa kuuboonku sheego oo keliya.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.a: Kuuboonku wuu dhacay Khamiista, sidaa darteed dhimis ma jirto.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.a: Khamiistu waa April 30, '4월 30일까지' wuxuu ku jiraa maalintaas.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.b: Kuuboonku wuxuu ka jaraa 2,000 won cabitaan kasta, sidaa darteed 4,000 wadar ahaan.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.b: '1회 사용' macnaheedu waa hal isticmaal kuuboon walba, ma aha hal isticmaal cabitaan walba.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.c: Ku darista dhimis kale waxay ka dhigaysaa kaydka mid ka weyn 2,000 won.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.r.c: '다른 할인과 중복 불가' macnaheedu waa dhimisyada lama isku dari karo.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.o.d: Hal kuuboon wuxuu ka jaraa 2,000 won hal mar, ma aha 4,000.
n-k-k6-03.s.s1.explain: Maanta waa Isniinta 27-keeda, sidaa darteed Khamiistu waa 30-ka, maalinta ugu dambeysa ee sax ah. Kuuboonku waa hal isticmaal oo lama isku dari karo, sidaa darteed laba cabitaan weli waxay helayaan 2,000 won oo dhimis ah wadar ahaan.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.prompt: Qorshuhu waa Khamiista qiyaastii 3 p.m. makhaayadda dugsiga hortiisa. Su'aashee aan kuuboonku ka jawaabin oo weli joojin karta qorshaha?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Su'aal kasta, raadi khadka kuuboonka ee ka jawaabaya; ka xariiq kuwa aad ka jawaabi karto.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Qaybtee qorshaha ah ayaan wax khad la daabacay daboolin?
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.a: Kuuboonku mar horeba wuxuu bixiyaa maalinta ugu dambeysa ee sax ah, Khamiistuna way ku habboon tahay.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.b: Kuuboonku mar horeba wuxuu leeyahay waxaa loo isticmaalaa hal mar kuuboon walba.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.r.d: Kuuboonku mar horeba wuxuu leeyahay wuxuu ka shaqeeyaa laan kasta oo 모아카페 ah.
n-k-k6-03.s.s2.explain: Taariikhda, tirada isticmaalka iyo laamaha waxaa lagu daabacay kuuboonka. Khadka ugu dambeeya wuxuu furan yahay 'shuruudo kale', waqtiga maalintuna waa mid muhiim noqon kara booqasho 3 p.m.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.prompt: U jawaab 민아 af Kuuriyaan (해요체 saaxiibtinimo). Si tartiib ah u sax fikradda 4,000 won, oo weydii ama soo jeedi hubinta su'aasha furan.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.0: Qor laba qaybood oo gaaban: waxa aad ka ogtahay kuuboonka, kadibna waxa aad rabto inaad ogaato.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.hint.1: Isticmaal dhammaad soo jeedinaya ama weydiinaya, sida '-(으)ㄹ까요?'.
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma sheegay waxa kuuboonku runtii bixiyo (hal dhimis 2,000 won ah)?
n-k-k6-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ma su'aashaydu waxay ku saabsan tahay hal shay oo kuuboonku aanu sheegin?
